attributes.visState: {"title": "About this dashboard", "type": "markdown", "aggs": [], "params": {"fontSize": 12, "openLinksInNewTab": false, "markdown": "BIND's own record of its answers (dnstap) next to the DNS traffic Elastic's Network Packet Capture integration sees on the wire. If the capture runs on the BIND servers, both see the same lookups, so panels compare the sources instead of adding them up. Only the wire shows DNS servers other than BIND and queries that never got an answer."}}
